newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo year results due Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Anglo year results due Tuesday.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd will announced its year results on Tuesday at 1400 GMT, the group said in a statement on Monday.
Anglo is expected to harvest wealthy profits from its sister companies De Beers Consolidated and Minorco SA to grow its year earnings by about 27 percent, analysts said last week.

Analysts polled by Reuters forecast a consensus headline earnings per share figure of 2,220.5 cents compared to the previous year's 1,743 cents. Their numbers lay within a range of 2,165 and 2,294 cents.
They forecast a consensus dividend of 690 cents per share within a range of 680 cents to 700 cents and compared to 570 cents previously.
